notes.notes:
New Background:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30467521/726f38c612bdb108e1f8009cee08b50ced419745.png[/img]

New Soundtrack
and also fix a bug that in Windows, some soundtrack only play once then turn into silence. It is becoz there is an error happened now when error happens, the mediaplayer will automatically restart thus the music will not be terminated.
